alarm_clock.definition: A small clock that rings in the morning to wake you up.
alarm_clock.example: My alarm clock rings at six.

att_fearful.definition: Describing a person who wants closeness and is afraid of it at the same time.
att_fearful.example: Fearful-avoidant behaviour often looks like pulling back right after reaching out.

attention_span.definition: The length of time you can hold focus on one task. It depends on the task and on your state, not on a fixed personal rating.
attention_span.example: My attention span on a spreadsheet is fine; it is the phone that breaks it.

war_logistics.definition: The work of moving and supplying the fighting: food, fuel, ammunition, vehicles and spares.
war_logistics.example: The report says the problem was logistics, not the fighting.

war_objective.definition: The result a plan aims at, written so that it can be judged done or not done.
war_objective.example: The brief states the objective in one line: the river crossing.

warning_triangle.definition: The red reflective triangle placed on the road behind a stopped vehicle so drivers see it in time.
warning_triangle.example: Put the warning triangle out about 100 metres behind the car.
